subject: Scope confirmation + PoC onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Sara Owens <sara@medtech.ai>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@medtech.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Scope confirmation + PoC onboarding checklist

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard and the proposed PoC onboarding path so we're aligned before I send the formal proposal: 

Pain points you called out
- Inference latency at peak for clinical-record summarization (target: 200–300ms p95)
- Cost variability when batch sizes spike during overnight processing windows
- Auditability: need token-level logs for a subset of requests for compliance review

Current stack and constraints
- Primary infra: GCP (us-central1), microservices in Go + Python
- Model: internal fine-tuned Llama variant (v2.3) running in-house today
- Security: data must never leave VPC; customer-managed KMS required

Success criteria for PoC (we discussed these as deal-go/no-go checkpoints)
1) Latency: achieve p95 <= 350ms for 2k concurrent short requests in our dedicated setup
2) Cost: demonstrate >=25% token-cost reduction relative to current baseline via batching + KV caching
3) Compliance: provide evidence of audit logs and KMS integration for test dataset

Proposed integration & onboarding plan (timeline and owners)
- Week 0 (next week): NDA signed + access checklist — Mina leads (me)
- Week 1: Environment setup — Redwood Private test VPC; Ben owns infra setup
- Week 2: Model ingestion & compatibility test — Grace to validate model format / quantization path
- Week 3–4: Performance tuning & smoke tests — joint runs with MedTech devs; deliver latency/cost snapshots
- Week 5: Acceptance run and handoff to pilot app team

Technical notes we need from you (action items)
- Confirm which endpoint patterns will be used (batch vs. single-call flows)
- Share a 1k-request sample (anonymized) and the current p95 baseline numbers
- Provide KMS key ARN and whether any egress proxies are required inside your VPC

Attached: redwood-poc-proposal-v1.pdf (draft timeline + SOW), api-compatibility-matrix.csv (fields we need to validate)

Next steps
- Sara / Tom: confirm NDA and whether you want Redwood to provision a Private test VPC or if you'll provide an environment (reply by Tue EOD if possible)
- Mina/Ben/Grace: we will schedule the infra kickoff once NDA is in place

Thanks — I can hop on a 30m follow-up this week if you prefer to walk the plan step-by-step.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

---

Thanks Mina — this looks good and aligns with what Tom and I discussed. A couple quick clarifications:

- We will provide an anonymized 1k sample by Monday morning.
- We prefer Redwood to provision the Private test VPC to speed things up; we will still enforce our KMS requirement.
- Regarding the audit logs: can you confirm retention options (30/90/365 days)?

I'll loop in our security lead if we move forward with NDA. For now, NDA is fine — I'll send a signed copy by Tuesday.

Sara

MedTech AI
